title: Dillon Gabriel will start, Taylen Green will back him up in Browns' preseason finale

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dillon Gabriel will start, Taylen Green will back him up in Browns' preseason finale
sources.description: With Deshaun Watson anointed as the Browns' starting quarterback and Shedeur Sanders his backup, neither will play in the preseason finale on Thursday against the Patriots.
